# Which corpus modules run in compiled fast mode, and why the rest do not.
# Rewritten by `UPDATE_EXPECT=1 cargo test --features sim eligibility`.

testdata/sim/casez.rtl
  enc: refused - process enc.stim: timing control (a wait or a delay) has no cycle-based meaning

testdata/sim/counter.rtl
  counter_tb: refused - process counter_tb.clkgen: a free-running process controls its own timing, which a cycle-based run has none of
      also process counter_tb.stim: timing control (a wait or a delay) has no cycle-based meaning

testdata/sim/coverage.rtl
  cov_tb: refused - process cov_tb.clkgen: a free-running process controls its own timing, which a cycle-based run has none of
      also process cov_tb.stim: timing control (a wait or a delay) has no cycle-based meaning

testdata/sim/delta_chain.rtl
  chain: refused - process chain.p1: timing control (a wait or a delay) has no cycle-based meaning

testdata/sim/dff_cell.rtl
  cells_tb: refused - process cells_tb.clkgen: a free-running process controls its own timing, which a cycle-based run has none of
      also process cells_tb.stim: timing control (a wait or a delay) has no cycle-based meaning

testdata/sim/display.rtl
  fmt_tb: refused - process fmt_tb.p0: timing control (a wait or a delay) has no cycle-based meaning

testdata/sim/fifo_assert.rtl
  fifo_tb: refused - process fifo_tb.clkgen: a free-running process controls its own timing, which a cycle-based run has none of
      also process fifo_tb.stim: timing control (a wait or a delay) has no cycle-based meaning

testdata/sim/fifo_assert_fail.rtl
  fifo_tb: refused - process fifo_tb.clkgen: a free-running process controls its own timing, which a cycle-based run has none of

testdata/sim/finish_at.rtl
  fin: refused - process fin.clkgen: a free-running process controls its own timing, which a cycle-based run has none of
      also process fin.late: timing control (a wait or a delay) has no cycle-based meaning
      also process fin.p2: timing control (a wait or a delay) has no cycle-based meaning

testdata/sim/hier.rtl
  adder: eligible (1 comb ops, 0 edge ops, 0 registers, 0 bits)
  top: refused - process top.p0: timing control (a wait or a delay) has no cycle-based meaning

testdata/sim/inactive.rtl
  zero_delay: refused - process zero_delay.first: timing control (a wait or a delay) has no cycle-based meaning

testdata/sim/memory.rtl
  memtest: refused - process memtest.p1: timing control (a wait or a delay) has no cycle-based meaning

testdata/sim/nba_swap.rtl

testdata/sim/vcd.rtl
  wave: refused - process wave.clkgen: a free-running process controls its own timing, which a cycle-based run has none of
      also process wave.p2: timing control (a wait or a delay) has no cycle-based meaning

testdata/sim/vhdl_sensitive.rtl
  vhdl: refused - process vhdl.counter: the sensitivity list does not cover everything the body reads
      also process vhdl.stim: timing control (a wait or a delay) has no cycle-based meaning
      also process vhdl.watcher: a free-running process controls its own timing, which a cycle-based run has none of

testdata/sim/wire_conflict.rtl
  wires: refused - cell wires.t0: tri-state drive needs wire resolution, which two-state mode does not have
      also cell wires.t1: tri-state drive needs wire resolution, which two-state mode does not have
      also process wires.p0: timing control (a wait or a delay) has no cycle-based meaning
      also wires.bus: several drivers write the same bits, which needs wire resolution
      also wires.y2: several drivers write the same bits, which needs wire resolution
      also wires.y: several drivers write the same bits, which needs wire resolution

  case_latch: refused - cell case_latch.z$latch: level-sensitive storage: the value is kept when no branch assigns it

testdata/synth/case_latch.rtl

      also case_latch.y: only some of its bits are driven

      also case_latch.z: only some of its bits are driven
